notes: Executable vineyard-law constraints directly observable in VineyardBlock. Fixin and Vougeot density, irrigation and spacing rules are sourced from the same reviewed legal authorities as their strict wine specifications. Plantation en foule remains distinct from conventional rows: row-spacing limits apply only to row-planted parcels, while minimum vine-to-vine spacing applies to both rows and foule.

constraints.notes: Current Fixin specification requires at least 9,000 vines/ha, prohibits irrigation, limits conventional row spacing to 1.25 m, and requires at least 0.50 m between vines. Plantation en foule is allowed and is therefore not assigned an invented row spacing. The current specification states no special transitional measures.

The current INAO-linked Vougeot specification requires at least 9,000 vines/ha, prohibits irrigation, limits conventional row spacing to 1.25 m, and requires at least 0.50 m between vines. Plantation en foule remains an allowed physical pattern rather than being forced into a row geometry. The historical density transition is not generalized into a current exception.
